About Us
text: For more than a decade, Ynanch Hyzmat has delivered engineering, procurement, construction, maintenance, automation, and specialised industrial services to the oil & gas, petrochemical, energy, construction, and infrastructure sectors. Trusted by both national enterprises and international operators, the company combines internationally aligned engineering practices with deep local expertise to execute complex projects safely, efficiently, and to the highest technical standards. Today, with over 1,200 completed projects, more than 300 strategic partners, and licenses covering 21 industrial activities, Ynanch Hyzmat has established itself as one of Turkmenistan's most capable industrial service companies.

title: Ynanch Hyzmat purpose
text: As industries evolve and projects become increasingly complex, our purpose remains unchanged: delivering reliable solutions that help clients operate with confidence. This commitment shapes both our mission today and our vision of becoming a lasting pillar of Turkmenistan's industrial development.

title: Mission
text: To serve as the strategic bridge between advanced industrial solutions and Turkmenistan’s energy sector, delivering full-cycle maintenance and support that grows alongside our clients’ needs.

title: Vision
text: To be the foundational pillar of the Turkmen industrial landscape, recognized as the premier provider of full-cycle, reliable energy solutions. To set the standard for institutional reliability in Central Asia, where our name is synonymous with integrity, sustainable performance, and the long-term success of our partners.

title: History
text: Ynanch Hyzmat was founded in 2016 with a clear objective: to provide dependable industrial services that simplify complex maintenance and operational challenges for energy operators. Starting with a small team of technical specialists in Ashgabat, the company focused on delivering high-quality industrial maintenance services where precision, safety, and reliability were essential. Early success in the oil and gas sector created new opportunities. Following its first major shutdown project, Ynanch Hyzmat steadily expanded its capabilities by investing in specialised equipment, workshops, logistics infrastructure, and highly qualified personnel. Strategic partnerships with Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) operators, leading international manufacturers, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) enabled the company to broaden its expertise beyond maintenance into engineering, procurement, construction, automation, and integrated industrial solutions. Over the past decade, this measured and capability-driven growth has transformed Ynanch Hyzmat from a local service provider into one of Turkmenistan's most comprehensive industrial service companies. Today, the company supports state enterprises and international operators with multidisciplinary teams, nationwide operations, and the technical resources required to execute complex industrial projects safely, efficiently, and to consistently high standards.

title: Our Project Methodology: From Inquiry to Execution
text: At Ynanch Hyzmat, we believe that successful projects are built on a foundation of clear communication, rigorous engineering standards, and precise execution. Our methodology is designed to minimize risk, maximize efficiency, and ensure that every solution we deliver meets the highest international benchmarks.

title: Discovery & Inquiry
text: The journey begins with a deep dive into your operational requirements. We don't just supply products; we provide solutions. Consultation: We meet to understand your specific challenges, technical constraints, and long-term goals. Requirement Analysis: Our engineering team evaluates the scope to ensure the proposed solution is technically sound and fit for your specific industrial environment.

title: Planning & Engineering Design
text: Before we take action, we map the path to success. Solution Architecting: We develop a detailed technical proposal, including product selection, compatibility checks, and integration requirements. Resource Allocation: We identify the necessary technical expertise, materials, and logistical support required for your specific project. Project Roadmap: We establish a clear timeline, defining critical milestones and deliverables so you are never left wondering about the status of your project.

title: Execution & Implementation
text: We bring the plan to life through disciplined project management. Logistics & Procurement: Leveraging our strong international partnerships (such as our collaboration with industry leaders like ROCOL), we ensure timely sourcing and delivery of high-quality components. Technical Deployment: Our experienced team carries out the work—whether it is installation, maintenance, or systems integration—adhering strictly to safety protocols and manufacturer guidelines. Quality Assurance: Every stage of execution is monitored to ensure the results align with the initial project specifications.

title: Testing & Commissioning
text: We do not consider a project finished until it is performing exactly as intended. Verification: We conduct rigorous functional testing to ensure all systems are operating at peak efficiency. Optimization: We fine-tune the deployment to ensure it integrates seamlessly with your existing infrastructure. Client Handover: We provide all necessary documentation, technical manuals, and brief your team on optimal usage to ensure longevity and reliability.

title: Ongoing Support & Partnership
text: Our commitment doesn't end at completion. After-Sales Support: We offer continued technical advisory, maintenance support, and training to ensure your investment delivers value for years to come. Feedback Loop: We value your input and perform post-project reviews to continuously refine our services and better serve your future needs.

title: Our Partnership Philosophy

title: Our Culture
text: At Ynanch Hyzmat, we believe that an industrial project is more than just a transaction—it is a collaboration. We view ourselves as an extension of your team, dedicated to the sustained performance, safety, and productivity of your operations in Turkmenistan.

title: The Principles of Our Decision-Making
text: We don’t just follow processes; we internalize them. Our internal culture is built upon three pillars that ensure our team remains agile and effective: Evidence-Based Engineering: We don't rely on guesswork. Every technical recommendation and project pivot is supported by data, manufacturer specifications, and real-world field analysis. We prioritize the facts to ensure your infrastructure remains safe and reliable. Decisiveness with Responsibility: Our culture empowers our team to make informed, timely decisions. We understand that in industrial environments, downtime is expensive. Effective maintenance not only minimizes unplanned downtime but also extends asset life and ensures compliance with industry safety standards.

title: HSE Objectives & Targets
text: Every task we perform is guided by rigorous risk assessment - from routine job safety analyses to formal reviews before new projects or equipment changes. High-risk activities are governed by strict Permit to Work controls, and our teams conduct monthly cross-departmental Hazard Hunts to catch risks before they become incidents.

title: HSE Objectives & Targets
text: Safety starts with knowledge. Every employee, contractor, and visitor completes HSE induction before site access, and our workforce maintains 98%+ on-time completion of safety certifications. Weekly Toolbox Talks keep teams aware of the risks specific to their daily tasks.

title: HSE Objectives & Targets
text: We're shifting from reacting to incidents to predicting and preventing them. Every employee contributes at least 3 safety observations a year, near misses are investigated within 48 hours, and corrective actions are closed at a 95%+ rate. Our goal: no hazard should ever be found by an external auditor before we've found it ourselves.

title: HSE Objectives & Targets
text: Safety commitment starts at the top. Senior managers conduct monthly site safety walkthroughs, lead Toolbox Talks, and participate in monthly HSE Committee Meetings - and HSE performance is now built into every employee's annual appraisal.

title: HSE Objectives & Targets
text: Safety is everyone's responsibility. Each employee reports at least 3 safety observations or near misses per year, complies fully with our Golden Rules and PPE requirements, and completes assigned training on time - with quarterly feedback on personal HSE performance.
